name: Sonken Chuubou
source:
One of the main female protagonists and main heroines in the Koihime†Musou series, she is a princess of the Go kingdom. Unlike her [url=/c19276]older sister[/url], she prefers peace for the people. She is insecure about being a ruler and questions herself often whether she's fit to carry the lineage's pride.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Koihime_Mus%C5%8D_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
